title: [main]A WIP Balance is presented incorrectly on the “Production Order – WIP” Report 5802 after Finishing Production Order Without Output Item Ledger Entry posted with new Manufacturing Setup option for no Output required.
summary: Report 5802 now displays a new Expensed WIP column to correctly show work-in-progress that was written off when production orders are finished without output, resolving a reconciliation issue with the general ledger.
key_points: Added Expensed WIP column to Report 5802 to display WIP written off for production orders finished without output
Created IsFinishedWithoutOutput helper to detect finished orders with no Output Item Ledger Entry
WIP amounts are reclassified from ending balance to Expensed WIP column when orders lack output
Report layout updated in RDLC, Word, and Excel formats to include the new column
New test verifies Expensed WIP equals written-off cost and ending WIP shows zero
quote: Added a dedicated "Expensed WIP" column to Report 5802 to represent the written-off WIP for production orders finished without output.
